fact: The World Bank's second implementation status report on the REPAIR project (P502472), dated 12 March 2026, states that the project was restructured in November 2025 after the GPE envelope was cut from US$53.1 million to US$39,737,250, that the revised agreements were signed on 24 November 2025, and that the project was not yet effective, with nothing disbursed and every result indicator at its baseline.
title: Implementation Status & Results Report: Restoring Education System Performance and Improving Resilience Project (P502472), Seq No: 2
